name: Close Contact
source:
You just got made captain of the Southampton Hawks, the newest co-ed rugby team in National One. Your dreams of winning a championship are finally within reach, but you've got a lot to prove on the field. Your coach has one strict rule: no fraternizing with the team.

You're confident you can handle it. Until your first match against the Wakefield Hounds and their captain, Devon. You've looked up to him since he made it into National One years ago, but in person, that charming smirk is infuriatingly hard to ignore. Worse, he's got the skills to back up the cockiness.

When you privately confront him after your team's loss, the encounter turns into an unexpected hookup. He leaves with one more smirk and a promise: "See you at the next match."

What follows are months of secretly hooking up with your arch-rival between matches, letting off steam while keeping it hidden from everyone. The physical attraction is undeniable, but the more time you spend together, the more you see past the swagger. He's supporting his ailing parents and desperately needs his team's bonuses to make ends meet. You open up about the pressure of living up to your late father's legacy and the weight of everyone's expectations.
translation:
你刚刚被任命为​​南安普顿老鹰队的队长，这是全国第一支最新的男女混合橄榄球队。你赢得冠军的梦想终于触手可及，但你还有很多东西需要在赛场上证明。你的教练有一条严格的规定：不能与球队称兄道弟。

你有信心你能处理好它。直到你与韦克菲尔德猎犬队及其队长德文郡的第一场比赛为止。自从他一年前进入国家队以来，你就一直尊敬他，但就他本人而言，他那迷人的傻笑令人难以忽视。更糟糕的是，他有能力支持这种自大。

当你在球队输球后私下与他对峙时，这次遭遇变成了一场意想不到的勾搭。他离开时又露出了一个傻笑，并承诺道：“下一场比赛见。”

接下来的几个月里，你会在比赛间隙与你的宿敌秘密勾搭，发泄情绪，同时又不让所有人知道。身体上的吸引力是不可否认的，但你们在一起的时间越多，你就越能看到过去的招摇。他要赡养生病的父母，并且迫切需要团队的奖金来维持收支平衡。你敞开心扉讲述了实现已故父亲遗产的压力和每个人期望的重担。
